page_title: LEC 3-2 FIO | Lecce v Fiorentina 02/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+2' 3 - 2 Goal! Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 3:2.

90+2' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Pietro Terracciano guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
90' 2 - 2 Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) finds the back of the net after rising highest in the penalty area to head the ball inside the left post!
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Antonio Giua shows a yellow card to Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
89' The linesman makes the right call and Fiorentina will have a corner.
88' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) produces a good strike towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
87' A player from Lecce commits a rough challenge. Antonio Giua blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
83' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Antonio Giua didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
78' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Lucas Beltran will be replaced by Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina).
78' That's the end of the game for Lameck Banda, who is replaced by Nicola Sansone (Lecce).
77' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sees a yellow card from Antonio Giua after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
75' Substitution. Antonino Gallo makes way for Patrick Dorgu (Lecce).
75' Roberto D'Aversa prepares a substitution. Mohamed Kaba is replaced by Joan Gonzalez (Lecce).
74' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 1:2.
72' Today's referee Antonio Giua rightly decides to book Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) for his harsh tackle.
68' We are about to witness a substitution. Roberto Piccoli (Lecce) is replacing Remi Oudin.
67' 1 - 2 Goal! Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Wladimiro Falcone and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 1:2.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina) is coming onto the pitch as Riccardo Sottil cannot continue after picking up an injury.
64' Lameck Banda (Lecce) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
60' Lameck Banda (Lecce) is caught offside!
59' Antonio Giua blows for a foul after Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
59' Fiorentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
59' Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Fiorentina force their opponents to concede a corner.
57' Lameck Banda (Lecce) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
55' Maxime Lopez (Fiorentina) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Wladimiro Falcone.
54' Remi Oudin (Lecce) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.

50' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Wladimiro Falcone just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.
50' Antonio Giua shows a yellow card to Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) for a tough tackle.
49' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the right post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
46' The game is over for Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina). Andrea Belotti comes on for the second half.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Vincenzo Italiano gives a chance to Rolando Mandragora and Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) is off.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) comes off for Nikola Milenkovic.
46' Antonio Giua blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' The ball is out of play. Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner.
45+1' Lameck Banda (Lecce) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender. The ball is out of play and Lecce manage to earn a corner.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
44' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 36:64.
40' Davide Faraoni (Fiorentina) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wladimiro Falcone, who smothers the ball.
37' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
35' Davide Faraoni (Fiorentina) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
33' Some great controlled play and passing from Fiorentina. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
30' The shots on goal statistics – 2:0.
27' Post! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
25' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
25' Fiorentina keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
22' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) but poses no threat.
17' 1 - 0 Remi Oudin (Lecce) scores from the free kick with a daisy-cutter that goes under the jumping wall and into the bottom left corner. What a cheeky free kick that is!
15' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Antonio Giua ignores the protests.

12' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) displays brilliant awareness inside the box to pounce on the rebound. From a difficult position he directs a header towards the middle of the net, but Pietro Terracciano pulls off a decent save to deny him.
11' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the left post.

8' Remi Oudin (Lecce) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
8' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. Lecce are awarded the free kick.
7' Antonio Giua blows his whistle. Giacomo Bonaventura (Fiorentina) commits a foul after dangerous play.
5' Fiorentina keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
4' A pass from M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is intercepted by Wladimiro Falcone and the move breaks down.
3' Alexis Blin (Lecce) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Fiorentina was in an offside position.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Antonio Giua.
